The reservation record IS the authoritative source (no separate purchase log a human could audit), so the tools DISPROVE the claim -> nothing left to verify -> agent CAN fully resolve it (against the user) -> should have DENIED. Transferring to verify insurance when the authoritative record already shows none is dodge-a-denial. SHARPENING PRINCIPLE: factual dispute -> transfer proper ONLY IF the agents tools genuinely cannot verify (P016); if the authoritative record definitively resolves it (P040), deliver the answer, do not escalate.
